verdict.rationale: Unity documents unattended automation mainly as build and CI tooling. Build Automation runs multiplatform builds from version control, the Editor runs headless via command-line arguments, and the Unity CLI is aimed at scripts, CI pipelines and headless build agents. The AI Assistant claims to 'automate workflows', but it is prompt-driven inside the Editor, with no evidence that it runs autonomously in the background. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduled or triggered background automations beyond builds, and autonomous AI/agent jobs that run without a user present.
